pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark brown polygonal regions with relatively sharp edge gradients despite low image resolution. Spatial area of patches is large relative to the inter-patch space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Intersections are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes. Pixel thickness is consistent, appearing as narrow, linear channels between dark regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal line of the neck exhibits a jagged silhouette with low-amplitude, high-frequency pixel fluctuations against the background.
